emily: Quick ask for runtime 5252 final webinar dry-run: need a fast sanity + tail-latency sweep for the quantized demo model. Focus on cold-first-token and cache-miss extremes. Can you run a short reserved slot?

tyler_runtime: Yep. Please point me at the payload set, model pin, and which slices (region/variant) you need. Target wall time?

emily: payload: s3://marketing-artifacts/webinar/demo-mini-v2.json (30 prompts: 20 short, 10 long + 5 adversarial). Model: `redwood-instruct-lite-q4_0`. Want variants: cache_on, cache_off, cache_on_with_fallback. Keep total under 8m.

tyler_runtime: Understood. We'll run on dedicated if Sam can reserve. We'll collect p50/p90/p99 per-token and first_token_cold, and log any OOM/fallback events. Will also slice by region: us,eu. Save raw responses for up to 2 failing seeds.

sam_ops: reserving 10m slot on analytics-dedicated at 09:00 PT, pre-warming GPU. Tagging run prefix so marketing can pull artifacts.

tyler_runtime: run command:
```bash
./bench-runner --model redwood-instruct-lite-q4_0 \
  --payload s3://marketing-artifacts/webinar/demo-mini-v2.json \
  --variants cache_on,cache_off,cache_on_with_fallback \
  --region-slices us,eu --seed 42 --warmup 50 --duration 480 \
  --metrics p50,p90,p99,first_token_cold,oom_events \
  --save-raw 2 --out s3://redwood-results/marketing/webinar/1755554321/
```

bench-bot: Job 55501 queued on analytics-dedicated (ETA ~10m) :hourglass: Tag: marketing/webinar/demo-mini-v2

tyler_runtime: Run finished. Uploaded metrics + manifest: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-results/marketing/webinar/1755554321/metrics.json

tyler_runtime: Summary: cache_off p99 peaked ~920ms on 1 long adversarial prompt (eu slice). One OOM->cpu-fallback recorded for prompt_idx 7 in cache_off. Saved 2 raw captures.

emily: can you paste the manifest line for the OOM event?

tyler_runtime: manifest line: {"prompt_idx":7,"variant":"cache_off","slice":"eu","event":"oom","fallback":"cpu_q2"}

emily: perfect. tagging @ana_sales to flag EU leads if p99>600ms. Ana can you route?

ana_sales: yep i'll add a note on the inbound queue and attach the metrics link.

sam_ops: cleaned up reserved slot; artifacts retained 6 days.

emily: thanks team. Callout for slides: "Dedicated pre-warmed slot; warmup=50; seed=42; demo-miniset; results may vary on shared capacity." :thumbsup:
